_about: Third-party venue addresses this repo integrates against on chain 4663.
Every entry below was resolved on-chain, not copied from vendor docs.
WARNING - the canonical Uniswap V3 mainnet addresses are NOT the Uniswap
deployment on this chain, and they are not empty either. As of 2026-08-04,
each hold ~2110 bytes of an unrelated contract that answers no Uniswap
selector. A code-presence assertion (`code.length != 0`) PASSES on both.
Any deploy-time guard must assert identity - see `verification` per entry.

MorphoBlue.verification: 15582 bytes of code; struct layout pinned byte-identical to the vendored src/vendor/morpho/IMorpho.sol in MorphoSupplyMainnetFork.t.sol.

UniswapV3Factory.verification: feeAmountTickSpacing(100) == 1; getPool(WETH, USDG, 100) round-trips to 0x52e65B17fB6E5BA00Ed806f37Afcd2DaA50271Ca, whose own factory() returns this address.

UniswapV3NonfungiblePositionManager.verification: 24384 bytes of code; name() == "Uniswap V3 Positions NFT-V1", symbol() == "UNI-V3-POS", factory() == UniswapV3Factory above, WETH9() == WETH below. Discovered from the owner topic of a Mint log on the USDG/WETH 0.01% pool rather than from a published address list.

SushiLaunchpadV1.verification: Verified source on robinhoodchain.blockscout.com as SushiLaunchpad (solc v0.8.36); 2366 TokenLaunched events. Identity, not presence: WETH() == WETH below, v3Factory() == SushiV3Factory below, positionManager() == SushiV3NonfungiblePositionManager below. Live params read 2026-08-28: launchFee() == 5e14 wei, protocolReserveBps() == 300, defaultSushiFeeBps() == 3000, owner() == 0x6fA4080b70eed82Cf48570DDE705026905a64657. quoteTokenPriceFeed(WOOD) == address(0) at that date -- WOOD-paired launches revert UnsupportedQuoteToken until the venue owner registers a WOOD/USD aggregator.

SushiV3Factory.verification: feeAmountTickSpacing(10000) == 200 (the 1% tier the launchpad mints into). Round-trip closed: getPool(WOOD, WETH, 3000) == WoodWethSushiV3Pool below, whose own factory() returns this address. Distinct from UniswapV3Factory above -- the two venues do NOT share a factory on this chain.

SushiV3NonfungiblePositionManager.verification: name() == "SushiSwap V3 Positions NFT-V1", symbol() == "SUSHI-V3-POS", factory() == SushiV3Factory above, WETH9() == WETH below. Holds every launchpad LP position -- the launch creator never custodies one.

WoodWethSushiV3Pool.verification: fee() == 3000, factory() == SushiV3Factory above, liquidity() == 2.128e22 read 2026-08-28. The live WOOD/WETH venue behind the SHARE/WOOD pairing; also the only on-chain WOOD price source, and thin enough (~$437k) that the protocol admits its TWAP only under the min() ceiling in WoodTwapOracle.

StonkSafeLaunchpadV2Pads.verification: Verified source StonkSafeLaunchpadV2 (solc v0.8.24) on robinhoodchain.blockscout.com; one pad per quote lane, all 16 sharing one ABI. Every address above was confirmed on-chain on 2026-08-28 by reading quote() and matching it to the lane it is filed under -- the check that caught a transcription slip in the USDG V2 address. Live launch counts then: V2 WETH 199, STONK 62, GME 35, SPCX 10, AAPL 9, USDG 8, NVDA 4, USO 2; V3 WETH 1 and the rest 0 (fresh, so launchCount is NOT a usable identity signal for the V3 pads). Live params on every pad: launchFeeWei() == 0, creatorFeeBps() == 1650, protocolFeeBps() == 1650, lpFeeBps() == 5000. There is NO WOOD lane and no permissionless way to add one -- a StonkBrokers launch pairs against WETH, STONKBROKER, USDG or a stock token.

SafeLaunchLensV2.verification: Verified source SafeLaunchLensV2 (solc v0.8.24); 13007 bytes of code. All reads take the pad as their first argument. priceWei(WETH_V2_PAD, 1) answered 39847682795 on 2026-08-28, i.e. it prices a real launch on a real pad. Curve math MUST be read through this lens rather than reimplemented -- the tax schedule changes every minute.

PonsLaunchFactoryV2.verification: Verified source PonsLaunchFactory (solc v0.8.30) on robinhoodchain.blockscout.com; ~266k transactions. Identity round-trip closes: factory.locker() == PonsLaunchLockerV2 below, whose own factory() returns this address. Live state read 2026-08-31: launchFee() == 5e14 wei native, launchConfigCount() == 1, dexConfigCount() == 1, owner == 0x263ed295dAFaE1d9AAdD6E56c4B6F9f38eE019Dd. Launch config 0 = {pairToken: WETH, graduationThreshold: 4.2e18, initialTick: -204200, supply: 1e27, maxWalletBps: 500, maxTxBps: 550, restrictionBlocks: 2, enabled: true}. Dex config 0 = 'uniswap v3' on the CHAIN'S CANONICAL UniV3 (factory 0x1f7d7550..., positionManager 0x73991a25..., router 0xCaf681a6... -- the same entries already in this book), 1% pool fee, tickSpacing 200. NOT USABLE YET: launchToken reverts NotWhitelisted unless launchEnabled (reads FALSE) or whitelistedLaunchers[caller]; the v1/legacy factory 0x0c37a24F5D23A486FA692d1500881d698B1F77a4 carries the IDENTICAL gate and the same owner, so it is no escape.

PonsLaunchLockerV2.verification: Verified source PonsLaunchLocker (solc v0.8.30). factory() == PonsLaunchFactoryV2 above. Holds every launch's LP position, locked -- the creator never custodies one. Two access facts the adapter design rests on: setFeeRedirect(token, wallet) authorises launched.deployer OR the factory, so the launching adapter can re-point fees after the launch; collectFees(token) authorises owner, deployer, the current recipient, or an allowlisted feeCollector, pays the current feeRedirects[token], and reverts NoFeesToCollect() when nothing has accrued.
